Answer: B
Reason: The ultrasound images demonstrate a multicystic mass in the fetal thorax with a visible systemic feeding vessel (indicated by color Doppler), which is characteristic of a bronchopulmonary sequestration or hybrid lesion typically located in the lower or middle lobe. Such space-occupying lesions commonly cause mass effect, resulting in displacement of the heart to the contralateral side and elevation of the ipsilateral hemidiaphragm.
